1936, August
FATHER SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 6.
Page 138 Cont.
Aug. 26 Peter Henning - 64 - has to support family - has running sore on leg.
Bridget Martin - 85 - tuomer. . .. Mrs. M. O'Conner - 87 - blind Ella M. Vigeon - 19 - convulsions almost every day - beautiful and happy otherwise.
Page 139
Aug. 26 Mrs. Anna Soderlund - about 55 - operated last Xmas time - hopeless then - seems pulling along - not worse.
27 Dennis La Porte - 31 - T.B. Sanitorium - wife deaf & dumb - have two children.
29 Francis Tawart - 38 - lost good job through drink. - had been care- less in receiving holy Sacraments, etc. He enrolled .... and started back to daily Communion and to his astonishment was called to employ- ment by one who had decidedly refused him the day before.
1936, September
September 8th Mrs. C. J. Kirchner - 77 - Heart quite improved, now asks prayers as against Eye & Ear failure.
James Ross - 30 - overcame drink - Margaret Ross -
John Monday - 49 - hands are stiff - has left off going to Church.

R. Walter Brann - 4 - 15 lbs. ...
9 Mrs. Helena Ouellette - 54 - Jandis - - operation threatened.
10 E. Fr. Morrison - 26 - of Youngstown O. - Epileptic - has had them about 12 years.
Mrs. M. Pray - Presbiterian - 43 - cancer operation off and on Ernest Gilpin - 3 - bright but sadly helpless. ...
